title: MailMessageSummary
description: One message in a mask, burner or agent inbox, as OpenVibe.Mail's list API returns it: the id, the senders, the subject and the time. It deliberately has no preview and no body: a message body is read only by the verification-code endpoint, in memory, and is never part of a list, an event or a database row. additionalProperties is false so a field like body, preview or html fails the contract rather than leaking into an API.

id.description: The mail server's message id (a JMAP Email id). Opaque outside OpenVibe.Mail.

from.description: The sender addresses, as the mail server parsed them. An address list, not a display name.

subject.description: The subject line, or null when the message had none.

received_at.description: When the mail server received the message, ISO 8601 UTC, or null when it did not record a time.
